title: CPR in 60 Seconds: The 2 Numbers to Know
description:
High-quality adult CPR: 100 to 120 compressions per minute, about 5 to 6 cm deep, full chest recoil and minimal pauses (2025 AHA guidelines, Resuscitation Council UK). Call for help and an AED first. Learn hands-on CPR in a certified course.

Sources:
• 2025 AHA Guidelines, Part 7: Adult Basic Life Support. Circulation: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41122888/
• Resuscitation Council UK: Adult basic life support guidelines: https://www.resus.org.uk/library/2021-resuscitation-guidelines/adult-basic-life-support-guidelines

✅ Fact-checked as of 23 Nov 2026. Medical evidence and guidelines change; check the sources above for updates.

Follow for daily medical news and high-yield medicine, explained in 60 seconds.

Educational content only, not medical advice. Always follow local guidelines and talk to a qualified clinician about your own health.
